verdict.rationale: Whether a productivity/collaboration suite's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, since open-source alternatives exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any Workspace source code published under an open license. The machine-readable Discovery documents and API references describe proprietary APIs, not product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
